notes.title: Global Update 1.0.0..1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/8bee0ea6333772df380e09cacfcb1f653c6d7e47.jpg[/img]
I am sure you will be pleased with the update. New exciting gameplay, improved graphics and new features are waiting for you.

The game has been completely redesigned and optimized. We had to add some elements and temporarily remove others.
Earlier the game took up 21.2 GB, but after hard work on optimization the size was reduced to 2.68 GB. Now all models and objects are made in the same style. 

[h2]IMPORTANT! [/h2]
The map in multiplayer will be constantly refined with the help of game events, as implemented in Fortnite! That is, after updates to the game will appear events that will add interesting locations: dungeons, crossings to new biomes and so on. Your buildings and gameplay will not be affected!

The single-player mode has been completely redesigned, so you will have to start the game over! At the moment, only the first map with “chapter 1: introduction” is ready. This map will no longer be globally changed, but it will be where the game events will take place. The second map, “chapter 2”, is in development.
Work on the lore of the game world is completed, and now it will gradually lead you to the final game, where you will learn a lot of interesting and surprising!

[h3]Now about the global update of the game![/h3].
New mechanics “Restoration of buildings of the past civilization”

- Menu map has changed!
- New character customization (hairstyles and beards with mustaches)
- Updated house building mechanics (now all in one blueprint)
- New blueprint “path and fence” 
- New enemies “Undead, Knight, Ghost Sand Gel” 
- AI Mobs patrolling different areas of the island
- Added ability to define items and 
that can be added to containers.
- Added classification of abstract elements 
That can be added and used in hotbar slots 
slots, but cannot be used in other 
containers. These abstract items can be 
used for spells from the spellbook.
- Added correct display of item decay time 
in the item's tooltip. It now depends on 
the decay factor of the container.
- Added replication of container items 
for active players. You can now check if 
whether certain items are available for clients.
- Added the ability to group AIs together and 
be companions for players.
- Added a system of orders (go to a point, go to 
and attack the point, follow the target, attack the 
target, guard the target and hold 
position).
- Behavior trees have been updated and 
now ranged enemies are not as accurate and melee enemies are more dangerous
- Added an emotion system and 
corresponding animations for different 
types of emotions.
- To play the corresponding emotion, you 
need to press [Q] and select an emotion.
- Emotions can be used by players in 
multiplayer game in different situations.
- New types of static and 
interactive objects for placement. Added 
New logic for some new objects.
- Added fences for farms. Different 
variants and sizes.
- Added gates for farms. Several options. 
The player can interact with this object and 
open/close the gate.
- Added walls with spikes. Can be used to 
base defense. The spikes deal damage 
to any player who attempts to pass through 
through them.
- Added spiked gates. Can be used to 
base defense. The player can interact with 
this object and open/close the gate.
- Added a new workbench on which you can create towers to view from above and protect the settlement.
- Added the ability to build ready-made unique buildings that open up new possibilities.
- Added water storage. Automatically fills 
empty bottles with water.
- Added chicken coop. Allows chickens 
to breed from eggs laid in the coop.
- Added chicken feeder. Increases 
the growth rate of chickens and the speed 
they lay eggs.
- Added a pigsty for pigs. Allows 
to breed pigs.
- Added pig feeder. Increases growth rate 
growth rate of piglets and speeds up births 
pigs.
- Added new types of throwing items: normal bomb, contact bomb, knives, 
remote bomb and a special detonator for activation.
- Added the ability to throw various tools: axe, pickaxe, torch, sharp stone, shovel.
Tools can be picked up after throwing and used again. Throwing tools consumes the item's durability.
- Character attributes affect the damage of a shot. Notification of a headshot.
- Throwing bombs: regular bombs that explode after a certain amount of time, and contact bombs,
which explode on contact with any object.
- Remote bombs deal increased damage to any structures.
- Added support for save and load system
for dedicated servers.
- Added: dynamic behavior tree injection
tasks that allow you to modify parts of the
of the basic behavior tree at runtime
- Added: basic dynamic behavior trees
- Updated: behavior trees have been redesigned
to work with new dynamic behavior trees
trees
- Added: new keys on the board, such as
reach distance, threat distance, melee distance
attack distance and so on
- Updated: moving to quests has been redesigned
to use the new board keys
- Updated: check distance decorators
and action services with check logic
distance check logic have been redesigned
- Updated: all tasks, decorators and
services have been redesigned to optimize
performance
- Fixed: the save process for components
with data saving interface
- Fixed: problems with data saving
interface functions for different actors
- Added: selection option in hammer menu
menu, allowing you to pick up some building
objects and add them to the
inventory.
- Added: now when a construction object
is placed in tall grass or ferns, the foliage
disappears. After destroying such
object, the foliage will reappear.
- Added: now some types of placed
objects, such as bonfires, take into account
take into account the irregularity (direction
normals) of the landscape in
location. To test this, take
a drawing of a campfire and try to place it
fire on an uneven surface in
a given room.
- The first-person view has been updated. “V” key
- Added highlighting of items after dropping them off
- Updated the day and night system.
- Updated the time of year system. Now it does not load FPS
- Removed Mobs and textures that do not fit into the environment of the game world (later they will be redesigned and will return.
- Removed all languages except Russian and English (to return in the next updates as there will be a better localization)

- Fixes and updates will be released much faster and better.

By all this was a lot of changes that you will see during the game.
Write bugs in discord and community game. I am carefully watching and listening to your wishes!

notes.title: Global Update Version 2 Part 1
notes.content:
In this update you will see: 

New localization and new languages in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/4844bc38905c5af2c543fbadb3507c0c629b5e40.jpg[/img]
New water - now the water looks more beautiful and more natural.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/da31cd01c8d9ba7eca2511ca952f320afa310ca6.png[/img]
Fishing - by creating a fishing rod and dripping worms, you will definitely not stay hungry. (in single you can fish everywhere. reservoirs have been created in multiplayer)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/a2b117a5e881b34ae00971b6874a44fed851543d.png[/img]
Pets - now you can meet pigs and chickens that you can tame and become a real farmer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/be62e1983080b3f20149c65a904ef24e9a2ce2cc.jpg[/img]
A new map in multiplayer mode - the restart of the map is caused by the fact that we decided to release updates as they do in Fortnate.... i.e. the map will expand, new buildings will appear and there will be a full-fledged story with videos.

New buildings - Now you can make houses for pets, new decorations for the house, build a high fence and gates, put different types of stakes (thereby protecting yourself from hostile creatures) and build 2 new workbenches.

the 1st workbench is used to create various fences and everything that will be useful to you in your fortress
2nd is a forge where you will build the most powerful weapons, new tools and magical devices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42004040/27f785adff009347de2aa80a5b6c78191c66f794.png[/img]
New Minerals - Now you will meet 2 new minerals. The 1st is a blue crystal, the 2nd is red. they serve for crafting powerful and irreplaceable things.

added water source crafting - now you can collect water from your own well

Assistants - now you can hire pirates to guard your home or your life (works only with non-aggressive ones)


As well: 
- returned and corrected the plot in single-player mode (the test mode will start after passing the story mode)
- fixed bugs with the departure from the game
- improved the artificial intelligence of mobs
- removed the wolf as soon as it can be tamed
- The weather is being adjusted. on version 1 it may be dark at night
- multiplayer dungeons are disabled for now and only works under the waterfall (they will work in version 2)

Road map
-The weather will affect the game map (there will be snow in winter, puddles in the rain)
-new light sources will appear "in part 2"
-more variations of construction objects "in part 2"
-a new and very beautiful color of the map "in part 2"
-new mobs "wolf, bear, ghost, deer, fox, merchant cat
